claims: Olivier Rioux is a 7-foot-9 (93 inches) center for the University of Florida Gators men’s basketball team.
Olivier Rioux is recognized as the tallest college basketball player in NCAA history.
Olivier Rioux previously held the Guinness World Record for tallest teenager.
Olivier Rioux joined the Florida Gators as part of the 2024 roster/2025 class.
Olivier Rioux hails from Montreal, Quebec, Canada.
Olivier Rioux was officially confirmed as the world's tallest teenager in 2021.
Olivier Rioux played for Canada’s U17 national team before joining the NCAA.
Olivier Rioux played for Canada’s U18 national team before joining the NCAA.
